# Tuning menu

The Tuning menu gives you direct access to the most important maps, grouped in submenus.
Each entry opens that map of the open file in a map viewer.
An entry only shows when the binary has the map, so BioPower, Myrtilos and gas maps only show on software that has them, and an empty submenu is hidden.
Point at an entry to see which symbol it opens.

The menu is rebuilt when you import a descriptor, so a stripped binary gets its entries too.

## Tuning → Diagnostics

The knock count map, false knock map, real knock map and misfire map, read from the connected ECU.
These are the same as the View items in the Realtime menu.

## Tuning → Calibration

Sensor and air calibration maps: AirCompCal.PressMap, AirCtrlCal.map, AreaCal.Area and AreaCal.Table, MAFCal.m_RedundantAirMap, TCompCal.EnrFacTab and EnrFacE85Tab, VIOSMAFCal.FreqSP and Q_AirInletTab2.
Ethanol adaption value is E85.X_EthAct_Tech2, read from the ECU.

## Tuning → Injectors

Injector constant
:   The injector constant (InjCorrCal.InjectorConst), to compensate for different injectors.

Injector dead time and Injector dead time (Y)
:   The battery voltage correction of the injection time (InjCorrCal.BattCorrTab) and its voltage axis.

## Tuning → Airmass

Pedal request map and Pedal request airmass (Y)
:   Pedal position/airmass per combustion map (PedalMapCal.m_RequestMap), and the Y axis for the pedal position calculation.

Air/Torque calibration and Air/Torque (X)
:   The air vs torque calibration map (TorqueCal.m_AirTorqMap).
    Converts torque to airmass per combustion in T7.

Nom. torque map and Nom. torque map (X)
:   The nominal torque map (TorqueCal.M_NominalMap).
    Converts airmass per combustion to estimated torque in T7.

## Tuning → Fuel

VE map
:   The Volumetric Efficiency map (BFuelCal.Map).

Startup / E85 VE map
:   The startup Volumetric Efficiency map (BFuelCal.StartMap), or the E85 map on BioPower software.

Gas VE map
:   The VE map for gas, on software that has it.

Enrichment factor during starting, and for E85
:   The fuel enrichment while cranking.

Enable closed loop regulation
:   LambdaCal.ST_Enable.

Injection end angles
:   InjAnglCal.Map.

Fuel cut, Closed Loop and TransCal
:   Submenus with the fuel cut on engine braking (FCutCal), the maximum load for closed loop (Max load norm, Max load E85) and the transient fuel enrichment and enleanment (TransCal).

## Tuning → Ignition

Ignition map
:   The main ignition map (IgnNormCal.Map).

Ignition for E85 and Ignition for Gas
:   The ignition map for E85 fuel and for gas (if present).

Ignition Idle and Ignition Start
:   The ignition at idle and while starting.

Knock pull map
:   The knock ignition map (IgnKnkCal.IndexMap).

Max knock pull
:   The maximum ignition pull map (KnkFuelCal.fi_MapMaxOff).

## Tuning → Boost

Boost calibration
:   The turbo boost calibration (bias) map (BoostCal.RegMap).

P factor, I factor and D factor
:   The P, I and D factors for the PID controller that handles boost.

Boost Temp Compensation and its (Y)
:   The boost control's correction for temperature.

## Tuning → Knock

Knock enrichment
:   The knock enrichment map, how much extra fuel should be injected in case of knock detection.

Knock sensitivity
:   The knock sensitivity factors, lower values means less sensitive to knock.

## Tuning → Limiters

Manual
:   For manual gearboxed cars: Airmass (M), the maximum airmass limiter; Engine torque (M) and Engine torque for E85 (M), the engine torque limiters; Gear Torque (M) and Gear Torque (5th), the gear torque limiters.

Automatic
:   For automatic gearboxed cars: Airmass (A), Engine torque (A) and Engine torque for E85 (A).

RPM limiter
:   The engine speed (RPM) limiter.

Fuel cut
:   The fuel cut limiter, running more airmass per combustion than this value results in a complete shutoff of fuel.

Speed limiter
:   The vehicle speed (km/h) limiter.

Overboost
:   The allowed overboost (if enabled).

## Tuning → Adaption

The switches for the adaptions and functions around them: Temp limit for adaption, Fuelcut enabled, Closed loop regulation, Purge enabled and Biopower enabled.

## Tuning → Myrtilos

On Myrtilos software: the launch control settings and the wideband lambda maps (MyrtilosCal and MyrtilosAdap).
